elements.requirement: Section 8(1) applies where a right of a third party under section 1 to enforce a substantive term is subject to an arbitration agreement.
elements.quote: a right under section 1 to enforce a term (“the substantive term”) is subject to a term providing for the submission of disputes to arbitration (“the arbitration agreement”)

elements.requirement: Under section 8(1), the arbitration agreement must be an agreement in writing for the purposes of Part I of the Arbitration Act 1996.
elements.quote: the arbitration agreement is an agreement in writing for the purposes of Part I of the Arbitration Act 1996

elements.requirement: Where the conditions of section 8(1) are met, the third party shall be treated for the purposes of the Arbitration Act 1996 as a party to the arbitration agreement regarding disputes between himself and the promisor relating to the third party's enforcement of the substantive term.
elements.quote: the third party shall be treated for the purposes of that Act as a party to the arbitration agreement as regards disputes between himself and the promisor relating to the enforcement of the substantive term by the third party

elements.requirement: Section 8(2) applies where a third party has a right under section 1 to enforce an arbitration agreement providing for one or more descriptions of dispute between the third party and the promisor to be submitted to arbitration.
elements.quote: a third party has a right under section 1 to enforce a term providing for one or more descriptions of dispute between the third party and the promisor to be submitted to arbitration (“the arbitration agreement”)

elements.requirement: Under section 8(2), the arbitration agreement must be an agreement in writing for the purposes of Part I of the Arbitration Act 1996.
elements.quote: the arbitration agreement is an agreement in writing for the purposes of Part I of the Arbitration Act 1996

elements.requirement: Section 8(2) applies only where the third party does not fall to be treated under section 8(1) as a party to the arbitration agreement.
elements.quote: the third party does not fall to be treated under subsection (1) as a party to the arbitration agreement

elements.requirement: If the third party exercises the right under section 8(2), the third party shall be treated for the purposes of the Arbitration Act 1996 as a party to the arbitration agreement in relation to the matter with respect to which the right is exercised.
elements.quote: the third party shall, if he exercises the right, be treated for the purposes of that Act as a party to the arbitration agreement in relation to the matter with respect to which the right is exercised

elements.requirement: If the third party exercises the right under section 8(2), the third party shall be treated as having been a party to the arbitration agreement immediately before the exercise of the right.
elements.quote: and be treated as having been so immediately before the exercise of the right

thresholds.what: minimum number of descriptions of dispute between the third party and the promisor to be submitted to arbitration under an enforceable term
thresholds.quote: one or more descriptions of dispute between the third party and the promisor to be submitted to arbitration
